chapter: Jazz as art form or party music
title: New Orleans acceptance of jazz and serious listening
summary: She says New Orleans accepts jazz because of its love of a good time, and only a few people listen seriously.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: I think... most of the people... the majority of New Orleans people with your acquaintance would have that idea, you think?
The ones who consider music seriously at all... would... would enjoy sitting down and listening to... a good... jazz artist.
Do you think there's anything else you could add on the... topic of social... acceptance into all this jazz by New Orleans... acceptance and acceptability?

Well, I think that the social acceptance of... New Orleans jazz by New Orleans is... is strictly based upon... New Orleans... love for a good time. And that jazz has always represented a good time. And it still represents a good time. And... even though rock and roll, which is only a degenerate form of jazz... has... come to the floor lately... It still... can't replace jazz completely... as good time music.

Well... the bit about... listening to it... seriously... I think that... there are few people anyway... in New Orleans... among my... who... who... sit down... and give a lot of time to listening to music anyway... and I think among those who do... they will appreciate the fact that there are many jazz artists... who are worth sitting down and listening to.
